title: Woodland Prince
altText: Stunning pop surrealism graffiti mural by Mr Blob integrating an architectural circular window into a wooden birdhouse, featuring a psychedelic cheshire cat character against a misty forest background.
description: Created for the Walls of Giant festival in Esine, this site-specific mural integrates a real circular window into the painted scene, turning it into the entrance of a giant wooden birdhouse. Perched beside it, a psychedelic horned feline — the woodland prince of the title — lounges in stripes and spots against a misty forest of pale trunks dotted with glowing orbs.
